name: cinema-watch
description: Ticket hunts for Italian cinemas (UCI, The Space, Webtic cinemas and 18Tickets): Telegram alerts with the seat map when showings come out or good seats free up. Hunts, cinemas and settings are managed from the web UI, which is in Italian.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Configuration, state, seat maps, history and log. On start the container gives it to PUID:PGID.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User that owns the data folder and runs the app. 99 is nobody on Unraid.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group that owns the data folder and runs the app. 100 is users on Unraid.

variables.name: UI_PASSWORD
variables.description: Web UI password. Empty: no password.

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY
variables.description: 1 when a reverse proxy in front sets X-Forwarded-For. Only needed with a password, for the per-IP login lockout.

variables.name: TELEGRAM_TOKEN
variables.description: Bot token, if not set from the web UI. The web UI value wins.

variables.name: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
variables.description: Main chat, if not set from the web UI. The web UI value wins.
